label: etapa3-review
method: Fault injection. The loop only fires below full marks and three consecutive runs passed first time, so the defect was introduced deliberately (BracketWidth 60 -> 45 mm) to give it something real to find.

records.review_findings: FINDING: overall length along the base is 45 mm, not the required 60 mm — spreadsheet BracketWidth (B5) = 45 drives BracketPad.Length = 45.0 mm

caveats: One injected defect, not a sample. It shows the loop can find and repair a real dimensional error end to end; it does not show how often it helps.
An earlier attempt to measure this produced nothing at all: the findings parser could not read the backend's JSON event stream, so a correct reviewer report was silently discarded.
